description: Post-disaster landslide risk assessment in Gofa Zone, South Ethiopia Region (2024-09-04) is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by European Commission, Joint Research Centre. In July 2024, Gezei Gofa Woreda in Gofa Zone, South Ethiopia Region was struck by a catastrophic series of landslides, triggered by unusually heavy rainfall which caused the collapse of the unstable, deforested slopes; resulted in destruction of houses, significant infrastructures, as well as agricultural lands. Coverage: Gofa Zone, South Ethiopia Region. The portal files it under the publisher European Commission, Joint Research Centre. Its tags are Regions and cities, Environment, Copernicus, EMSN202, Mass movement. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
